nemean: The Nemean Lion of Greek myth: a massive lion whose hide gleams like burnished bronze-gold, impervious and slightly metallic, a thick heavy dark-gold mane with sculpted locks, old battle scars across the muzzle, intense pale gold eyes, powerful heavy paws with dark claws.
lion_gate: A Mycenaean temple guardian lion inspired by the Lion Gate of Mycenae: a lean regal lion with a pale limestone-cream coat, a short stylised mane of carved-looking spiral curls, a bronze collar with a small hanging disc, faint painted blue-black meander bands on the forelegs like ritual markings.
old_king: A grizzled old pride king: a scarred veteran lion with a tawny coat, one torn ear, a ragged mane of black fur streaked with grey that runs onto the chest and belly, deep claw scars across the shoulder, heavy brow, weary fierce eyes.
black_mane: A huge Atlas (Barbary) lion: deep warm ochre coat, an enormous dark brown-to-black mane that extends over the shoulders, chest and along the belly, dark tail tuft, strong broad head, striking amber eyes.
huntress: A lean Aegean island lioness huntress: sand-ochre coat with faint ghost rosette spots on the legs and flanks, black backs to the ears, a white chin and throat, long whip tail with a black tuft, sharp hunting gaze, wiry muscular build.
red_figure: A lion as painted on ancient Greek red-figure pottery come to life: terracotta-orange coat with fine black glaze line detail on muscles, a black mane drawn in rhythmic flame-like locks, black meander and dot pattern accents along the back, sharp profile features.
